problem.description: Detect and localize each animal in camera trap images from African savanna.

dataset.name: African Savanna Wildlife Dataset
dataset.description: Dataset of camera trap images containing various animals in the African savanna.
dataset.preprocessing: Resize images to a standard size (e.g., 224x224 or 256x256 pixels). Normalize pixel values to the range [0, 1] or [-1, 1]. Convert annotations to appropriate formats for object detection (e.g., bounding boxes).
dataset.augmentation: Horizontal flips, random crops, color jittering, rotation, scaling, and use of synthetic data generation (if applicable).

model.description: Faster R-CNN is an advanced object detection architecture that improves the speed and accuracy of detecting objects within images, making it ideal for real-time applications.
